name: eirik
description: A man in his late forties, an old soldier. A gruff, weathered baritone voice, slightly gravelly, with dry humour, unhurried.
reference_text: Twenty winters I have carried a shield, and I have never once had a proper breakfast. Is that porridge? Gods help us. Stand behind me and keep your blade low. Here they come! Hold! Good. Now we eat, and nobody complains about the salt.
